principles.rule: Every state change the user triggers should have visible feedback — toggle, price change, hover, focus.
Prices, counts, and metrics morph smoothly — use NumberFlow (@number-flow/react or number-flow vanilla), not textContent swaps.
Micro only: 150–400ms for UI state, ease-out. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (instant swap, animated=false).
Stack small motions: billing pill slide + digit spin + meta fade + material hue shift — not one giant GSAP timeline.
Premium hover does NOT move layout — no translateY lift on buttons, no translateX nudge on rows. Use color, opacity, background tint, or shadow depth only.

antiPatterns: translateY(-1px) button lift — cheap SaaS template, causes layout shift
translateX row slide on list hover — feels jittery on pricing cards
scale(1.02) on cards — shifts surrounding content
Hover that changes padding or margin
Magnetic cursor or bounce easing on task UI

mustHave: Animated price on billing toggle (NumberFlow or equivalent odometer)
Toggle segment with pressed state + subtle transition
Meta line updates in sync with price (opacity crossfade ok)
CTA hover: background + shadow depth only — no translateY lift
Optional: feature row background tint — no slide/transform
planCardLayout: Tier title needs top breathing room inside header band — not glued to card edge
Billing toggle needs top padding after header seam — not flush to body top
Single plan cards: Monthly before Annual in toggle order (Annual is alternate/savings)

mustHave: Metric cards use number morph on filter change
Stable hover — color/opacity/tint, no layout-shift transforms
